description: The mu2 target exists and is structurally ZERO (deuteron-anchored simplex), supplying the third point the anatomy probe named. It REFUTES the geometric per-order law k_n = a*r^n: k2 = 0 forces a = 0 or r = 0, either of which forces k3 = k4 = 0, contradicting the measured nonzero k3, k4. Scope-(b) with a cited invariant. Does not explain the magnitude gap and does not touch the scope-(a) wall.

mu2_target_is_structurally_zero.reason: the simplex is deuteron-anchored, so it reproduces the 2-body datum exactly and leaves no 2-body residual

geometric_per_order_law.argument: k2 = 0 forces a*r^2 = 0, hence a = 0 or r = 0; either forces k3 = k4 = 0, contradicting the measured nonzero k3 = 0.5486 and k4 = 5.2419. No finite (a, r) fits all three points.
geometric_per_order_law.scope: (b), cited invariant = structural vanishing of the 2-body residual

data.caveat: k2 = 0 is a property of the SIMPLEX's construction, not an independent measurement. It is the right third point because it is the same kind of quantity as k3 and k4 — target-over-measured for the same model against the same H12 cumulants — but re-anchoring the simplex away from the deuteron would require redoing it.
